title: Identification Painting and Inscription Code for Pilot Craft
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard applies to pilot craft used in closed waters estuaries and open roadsteads to bring and take off pilots to merchant ships.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Classification and Basic Requirements of Pilot Craft

clause_3_terminology: Identification Painting and Inscription Code for Pilot Craft

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
